comparison.objective: Calibrate a tool tip by touching one reference point from four sufficiently different angles; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Precise point contact, orientation changes and one-second pose stability versus hex-key engagement, collar rotation, counterholding and repeated impact observation.
comparison.success_condition: Four credited contacts with specified angular separation, contact accuracy and hold time versus two acceptable stopping cycles after relocking. Candidate dynamic thresholds are incomplete.
comparison.reason: Robot calibration through multi-pose point contact does not duplicate mechanical tuning, despite both being commissioning activities.
